name: Quit smoking
summary: Hand-curated quit-smoking services from libraries/quit-resources.json. Supportive, never shaming. No health-outcome claims.
slide_pattern: cover (the topic) → list (3–5 services, named) → statement (a supportive line) → cta
extra_voice_rules: Supportive, never shaming. Never 'you should', never 'just quit'.
No health-outcome claims. Never 'after 30 days you'll feel X'.
Name the service exactly as in libraries/quit-resources.json.
Country tags are part of the service identity; don't drop them.
extra_checks: Every service named in the post must exist in libraries/quit-resources.json.
Every URL in the post must equal a URL in the source file.
No health-outcome claim string anywhere in the post (checked against a banned-claim list).
